rationale: Price is at 93.8% of today's range and within $0.12 of the session high after a large intraday recovery from $16.39 to $18.22, suggesting most of the move is already captured. With only 41 minutes to close and the stock pressing against resistance at the day's high ($18.34), the risk/reward for a long is poor (limited upside, meaningful pullback risk), while a short against a strong uptrend with price above the 9-EMA and VWAP by a wide margin carries momentum risk. No news catalyst and elevated relative volume without a clear continuation or reversal signal makes this a low-confidence setup in either direction.
